svg.title: Count physical states once; pins overlap them
svg.desc: Four slots × 512 bytes = 2,048 backing bytes; metadata and workspace are additional
svg.text: Count physical states once; pins overlap them
Four slots × 512 bytes = 2,048 backing bytes; metadata and workspace are additional
Free → Reserved: assign a fresh identity
Free has no owner, pin, mapping or pending access.
Reserved already occupies one physical slot; it is not an unused growth credit.
Reserved → Live: write, complete, then seal
Named request and cache owners can share only authorized ready contents.
Retained-only storage is a Live subset; another owner does not add a block.
Live → Retiring: close attachment and remove the last owner
A submitted reader can still hold a pin after its request closes.
Pinned storage overlaps Live or Retiring; never add it as a fifth state bucket.
Retiring → Free: discharge every access and return once
No owners, pins, mappings or pending publication may remain.
Unknown completion stays quarantined or in a retired domain; timeout is not return.
Conservation: C = Free + Reserved + Live + Retiring. A stale generation never authorizes a reused slot.
